title: Puppy page template: the Biscuit page becomes the structure for every individual puppy page
hard_rules: Extraction, not redesign: section order, dossier, chips, marquees and the K-124 map/licence alignment are kept. Any visual difference from the prototype is listed as a named compromise (plan §4 C1-C7) and shown in screenshots, never shipped silently.

One structure, many puppies: no Biscuit-specific string survives in src/. Every per-puppy word comes from PuppyPageData; every shop term comes from src/data/buying-terms.ts or src/data/site.ts; every template sentence lives in src/data/puppy-page-copy.ts.
Variants extend the prototype's only-av / only-placed pattern with only-imp, resolved at build time (<Only on=...>). A hidden branch never reaches dist/; each built page has exactly one H1 text.

Honesty rules H1-H7 (plan §3): no invented temperament, dates, reviews, guarantees or prices; null hdbApproved is unknown; a cross is never the pure breed; no AI or stock imagery of puppies, families or the shop.
URLs, pupPageSlug, puppy-redirects, sitemap exclusions and imported noindex,follow are unchanged. Route count before == after.
Use existing tokens (src/styles/global.css) and existing components where they already do the job (ListingGrid/pupCard, FAQ, Schema, Breadcrumb). No new palette.
Read secrets only from C:\Users\admin\.claude\.env; never print them. No production deploy in this work order.

owner_decisions.D1: Payment methods: prototype 'PayNow or credit card' vs buying-terms.ts PAYMENT_LINE 'PayNow, bank transfer, cash at handover, or credit card'. Default: buying-terms.ts.
owner_decisions.D2: Hero availability line prints today's date only while syncedAt is inside the feed:check freshness window. Default: apply.
owner_decisions.D3: A non-Balestier (Choa Chu Kang) puppy gets no page. Default: apply.
owner_decisions.D4: breedFacts only from sentences already published on that breed's own page; breed without facts hides Breed fit. Default: apply.

go_live_blockers: T15 preview signed off by the owner
Imported variant terms still subject to the counsel sign-off recorded in reports/imported-puppy-legal-redline-2026-11-11.md
